spectral_hammer.description: Swing a spectral hammer through an eighteen-block section of natural terrain. Original hammer animation; normal drops and claims respected.

ice_block.description: Form a tracking ice block overhead, then drop it for seven contact damage and up to fourteen impact damage with freezing.

sculk_tentacles.description: Raise six animated sculk tentacles for fifteen seconds. Their eight-damage strikes blind nearby enemies.

greater_heal.description: Restore all of your missing health.

cleanse.description: Remove harmful effects from yourself, party members and your pets within three blocks.

fortify.description: Give yourself and nearby allies four temporary absorption hearts for two minutes.

haste.description: Increase spell casting speed by ten percent for thirty seconds. Aim at an ally to help them.

slow.description: Reduce the target’s spell casting speed by ten percent for twenty seconds.

teleport.description: Blink up to sixteen blocks along your view to a clear, permitted position.

summon_ender_chest.description: Open your own ender chest wherever you are.

touch_dig.description: Break one mineable block within eight blocks, with normal drops and claim protection.

wololo.description: Change a permitted sheep to a different wool colour.

angel_wings.description: Fly for thirty seconds using Jugcraft’s shared temporary flight system.

charge.description: Gain five percent movement, melee and lightning power for thirty seconds.

oakskin.description: Reduce incoming damage by twenty percent for thirty seconds; move twenty-five percent slower.

blight.description: Reduce the target’s damage by ten percent and healing by twenty percent for twenty seconds.

gluttony.description: Eating restores shared Focus for one minute. Reusable food is excluded.

root.description: Trap a permitted target in breakable forty-health roots for five seconds. Destroying the roots releases the target.

wisp.description: Send an animated pursuing wisp toward a permitted target for five damage. Blocks and attacks can stop it.

blessing_of_life.description: Restore six health to the ally or owned pet you are aiming at, up to sixty-four blocks away.

counterspell.description: Interrupt a permitted target’s active spell, dispel spellbook statuses, or destroy a Wisp or Root.

spider_aspect.description: Deal five percent additional damage to poisoned, withered or blighted targets for twenty seconds.

summon_vex.description: Summon three protective vexes for ten minutes. Shared summon limit: eight. Sneak-use the book to dismiss.

summon_polar_bear.description: Summon a twenty-four-health polar bear defender for ten minutes. Sneak-use the book to dismiss.

summon_horse.description: Summon a saddled spectral steed for ten minutes. Only its summoner can ride it; sneak-use the book to dismiss.

summon_swords.description: Summon a sword, a quick rapier and a durable claymore for ten minutes. Each uses its supplied animated model and distinct combat stats. Sneak-use the book to dismiss.

raise_dead.description: Raise three protective zombies or skeletons for ten minutes. They drop no equipment. Sneak-use the book to dismiss.

firebolt.description: Launch a firebolt for 6 damage; ignites targets. Respects claims, parties and PvP; never destroys terrain.

magic_missile.description: Launch a magic missile for 6 damage. Respects claims, parties and PvP; never destroys terrain.

icicle.description: Launch a icicle for 6 damage; freezes targets. Respects claims, parties and PvP; never destroys terrain.

fireball.description: Launch a fireball for 10 damage; ignites targets in a 3-block radius. Respects claims, parties and PvP; never destroys terrain.

magic_arrow.description: Launch a magic arrow for 10 damage. Respects claims, parties and PvP; never destroys terrain.

fire_arrow.description: Launch a fire arrow for 11 damage; ignites targets in a 3-block radius. Respects claims, parties and PvP; never destroys terrain.

poison_arrow.description: Launch a poison arrow for 5 damage; poisons targets. Respects claims, parties and PvP; never destroys terrain.

lightning_lance.description: Launch a lightning lance for 14 damage. Respects claims, parties and PvP; never destroys terrain.

wither_skull.description: Launch a wither skull for 6 damage; withers targets. Respects claims, parties and PvP; never destroys terrain.

guiding_bolt.description: Launch a guiding bolt for 3 damage; marks targets for your next critical strike. Respects claims, parties and PvP; never destroys terrain.

acid_orb.description: Launch a acid orb; weakens armor in a 3-block radius. Respects claims, parties and PvP; never destroys terrain.

ray_of_frost.description: Project a ray of frost for 12 damage; freezes targets. Respects claims, parties and PvP; never destroys terrain.

sonic_boom.description: Project a sonic boom for 20 damage; pushes targets away. Respects claims, parties and PvP; never destroys terrain.

shockwave.description: Release a shockwave for 10 damage; pushes targets away in a 9-block radius. Respects claims, parties and PvP; never destroys terrain.

frostwave.description: Release a frostwave; slows and chills targets in a 6.75-block radius. Respects claims, parties and PvP; never destroys terrain.

heat_surge.description: Release a heat surge; weakens armor and ignites targets in a 6.5-block radius. Respects claims, parties and PvP; never destroys terrain.

blood_needles.description: Release a blood needles for 2 damage; five converging needles restore a quarter of the health actually removed. Respects claims, parties and PvP; never destroys terrain.

acupuncture.description: Surround the aimed enemy with five inward-flying needles for two damage each. Walls can intercept them. Respects claims, parties and PvP.

blood_slash.description: Release a blood slash for 10 damage; a widening slash restores fifteen percent of the health actually removed. Respects claims, parties and PvP; never destroys terrain.

healing_circle.description: Place a five-block healing circle for ten seconds; heals nearby allies every two seconds.

blizzard.description: Send a slowly moving blizzard that freezes and swirls enemies for eleven seconds.

earthquake.description: Shake a chosen eight-block area for twelve seconds, damaging and slowing grounded enemies without breaking terrain.

thunderstorm.description: Carry a twenty-second storm that strikes visible enemies within twenty blocks every two seconds; no world-damaging lightning.

scorch.description: Scorch a chosen circle for eight damage, leaving a damaging burning field for ten seconds; never places fire blocks.

poison_splash.description: Erupt poison at the aimed location for eight damage, then leave a seven-second poison cloud.

blaze_storm.description: Hold the casting control to launch a stream of original animated fireballs for up to 2.75 seconds. Costs 1 Focus per 0.25-second pulse; release to stop. A loose scroll produces one pulse.

starfall.description: Hold the casting control to rain pairs of original animated comets over the first aimed location for up to 8 seconds. Costs 1 Focus per 0.2-second pulse; release to stop. A loose scroll produces one pulse.

fire_breath.description: Hold the casting control to sweep a short cone in front of you for up to 5 seconds. Costs 1 Focus per 0.5-second pulse; release to stop. A loose scroll produces one pulse.

dragon_breath.description: Hold the casting control to sweep a short cone in front of you for up to 5 seconds. Costs 1 Focus per 0.5-second pulse; release to stop. A loose scroll produces one pulse.

poison_breath.description: Hold the casting control to sweep a short cone in front of you for up to 5 seconds. Costs 1 Focus per 0.5-second pulse; release to stop. A loose scroll produces one pulse.

cone_of_cold.description: Hold the casting control to sweep a short cone in front of you for up to 5 seconds. Costs 1 Focus per 0.5-second pulse; release to stop. A loose scroll produces one pulse.

electrocute.description: Hold the casting control to sweep a short cone in front of you for up to 5 seconds. Costs 1 Focus per 0.5-second pulse; release to stop. A loose scroll produces one pulse.

ray_of_siphoning.description: Hold the casting control to drain health from the aimed enemy for up to 5 seconds. Costs 2 Focus per 0.5-second pulse; release to stop. A loose scroll produces one pulse.

cloud_of_regeneration.description: Hold the casting control to heal nearby allies for up to 10 seconds. Costs 2 Focus per 0.5-second pulse; release to stop. A loose scroll produces one pulse.

divine_smite.description: Smite a small area just ahead with eight damage plus the melee damage of your offhand weapon.

flaming_strike.description: Sweep enemies in a short forward arc for five damage plus your offhand weapon damage, igniting them.

shadow_slash.description: Slash the nearest enemy ahead and nearby foes, parry incoming projectiles, then surge toward the strike.

burning_dash.description: Dash forward, striking each contacted enemy once and leaving them burning. Terrain and claims constrain the dash.

volt_strike.description: Surge forward in lightning, striking contacted enemies once for six damage.

ascension.description: Launch upward in a lightning blast. Damage decreases away from you; brief fall protection follows.

chain_lightning.description: Strike an aimed enemy for six damage, then arc to up to three more enemies within four blocks of each link.

lightning_bolt.description: Call lightning at an aimed location. Ten damage at the centre falls away across four blocks; never starts fires.

fang_strike.description: Send eight evoker fangs forward in a travelling line. Fangs respect claims, allies and PvP.

fang_ward.description: Raise two expanding rings of evoker fangs around yourself.

stomp.description: Send a five-block ground shock forward, striking grounded enemies and throwing up harmless terrain particles.

soulfire_ray.description: Strike the first target along a thirty-block soulfire ray for twelve damage.

eldritch_blast.description: Cast three fifteen-damage beams within four seconds. Pay once; subsequent beams have no extra Focus cost.

flaming_barrage.description: Launch five cursor-steered fireballs within six seconds, for three damage each. Pay once for the volley.

gust.description: Push enemies in a forward eight-block gust; targets hurled into walls take collision damage. Casting against a nearby wall gives a small kickback.

throw.description: Throw a spectral copy of your offhand item for one damage plus its weapon damage. The original stays in your hand.

sacrifice.description: Consume an owned summoned defender to explode for twelve plus half its remaining health. No terrain damage or equipment drops.

snowball.description: Lob a snowball that chills nearby foes and leaves a four-block frost field for ten seconds.

magma_bomb.description: Lob an eight-damage magma bomb that leaves a four-block burning field for ten seconds.

lob_creeper.description: Throw an explosive creeper head for up to six damage. Explosions respect claims and never damage terrain.

chain_creeper.description: Scatter three creeper heads at the aimed location. A killing blast can create another ring, capped at two additional generations.

firecracker.description: Burst a firework at your aimed location for four damage to nearby foes.

arrow_volley.description: Rain five rows of five spectral arrows over the aimed location. Each arrow deals two damage and cannot be collected.

raise_hell.description: Cast three expanding ground eruptions within four seconds. Each reaches eight blocks and adds your offhand weapon damage. Pay once.

thunder_step.description: Launch a moving thunder orb, then cast again within five seconds to teleport to it and strike foes along your path. Maximum travel: thirty-two blocks.

blood_step.description: Blink up to eight blocks, or behind an aimed enemy, and gain five seconds of true invisibility.

frost_step.description: Blink eight blocks, leaving a frozen copy that distracts enemies and shatters into eight ice shards.

frostbite.description: For thirty seconds, killing a fully frozen foe leaves a frozen copy that taunts enemies and shatters into damaging ice.

echoing_strikes.description: Your next three melee or arrow hits within two minutes summon a sword or arrow echo for seventy-five percent of that hit’s damage.

devour.description: A spectral jaw bites the aimed enemy for six damage and returns fifteen percent as health. Kills grant two maximum health for one minute, stacking to twenty.

ice_spikes.description: Raise eight growing ice spikes along the ground. Small spikes deal six damage; the final spike deals twelve. They launch and freeze enemies.

abyssal_shroud.description: For six seconds, dodge incoming attacks into nearby clear, permitted ground. Fall and bypass damage still apply.

arcane_shackle.description: Launch an ender chain that tethers a permitted enemy to a breakable fifteen-health anchor for eleven seconds.

heartstop.description: Defer post-armour damage for ten seconds, then repay the entire accumulated debt. Cleansing or logout cannot erase the debt.

planar_sight.description: See nearby living creatures through terrain for forty seconds. Only your view changes.

pocket_dimension.description: Leave combat and enter your own persistent room. Touch its portal frame to return. The original room is built only on first entry.

telekinesis.description: Hold a permitted enemy along your gaze for up to seven seconds. Each tenth-second pulse costs one Focus; releasing stops the force.

evasion.description: Dodge the next incoming attack to safe ground. Lasts one minute; fall and bypass damage are excluded.

portal.description: Cast twice within two minutes to link two locations for five minutes, or two crafted Portal Frames permanently. Both endpoints must be loaded and permitted. Dye frames to recolour; sneak-use an empty hand to unlink.

recall.description: Outside combat, return to your bed or respawn anchor, or world spawn when no valid respawn point remains.

invisibility.description: Hide yourself and your equipment for ten seconds. Nearby enemies lose their target; attacking breaks the concealment.

scapegoat.description: Send an animated twenty-health decoy running toward your aim for fifteen seconds. Nearby permitted enemies chasing you follow it.

shield.description: Place a fifteen-health magical shield in front of you for twenty seconds. Its original animated surface intercepts projectiles and attacks crossing the shield.

black_hole.description: Create a six-block gravity well for thirty seconds. It draws permitted foes inward and deals two damage near the core every half-second. Terrain stays intact.

gravity_fissure.description: Send a moving gravity well forward for three seconds, drawing permitted foes with it without direct damage.

ball_lightning.description: Launch a five-damage lightning orb that can hit again after half a second. It bounces off six surfaces or expires after five seconds.

firefly_swarm.description: Send a pursuing swarm after your target for ten seconds. Its two-block cloud deals two damage every three-quarters of a second.

fang_swirl.description: Send fangs toward your aimed point, then sweep an eight-second, five-block ring of four-damage fangs around it.

sunbeam.description: Mark a two-block area with a narrowing column of sunlight. After three-quarters of a second it strikes for twelve damage.

wall_of_fire.description: Choose up to four ground anchors within two seconds to draw a thirteen-block fire wall. It lasts twelve seconds, burns foes and never ignites terrain.

ice_tomb.description: Enclose yourself in breakable ice for five seconds, healing one health each second. Sneak to leave early; attacks break the shell.
